001package org.clafer.compiler;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.Solver;
004import org.clafer.instance.InstanceModel;
005
006/**
007 *
008 * @author jimmy
009 */
010public class ClaferNoObjectiveOptimizer implements ClaferOptimizer {
011
012    private final ClaferSolver solver;
013
014    public ClaferNoObjectiveOptimizer(ClaferSolver solver) {
015        this.solver = solver;
016    }
017
018    @Override
019    public boolean find() {
020        return solver.find();
021    }
022
023    @Override
024    public InstanceModel instance() {
025        return solver.instance();
026    }
027
028    @Override
029    public int[] optimalValues() {
030        return new int[0];
031    }
032
033    @Override
034    public int instanceCount() {
035        return solver.instanceCount();
036    }
037
038    @Override
039    public InstanceModel[] allInstances() throws ReachedLimitException {
040        return solver.allInstances();
041    }
042
043    @Override
044    public Solver getInternalSolver() {
045        return solver.getInternalSolver();
046    }
047
048    @Override
049    public ClaferSearch limitTime(long ms) {
050        return solver.limitTime(ms);
051    }
052}
